cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: STATUS / TIMING
cards.text: Storyboard v1. 289 spoken words at 190 wpm = 91.3s; +2s tail = 93.3s. 36 narration beats. Times are planning estimates, not VO timestamps. No new keyframes, VO or video generated.

cards.title: MECHANISM BEFORE BRAND
cards.text: All three ingredient explanations must finish before S27 reveals Motilli. Order follows the approved script: apigenin → soluble fiber → chlorophyllin → combined formula.

cards.title: VISUAL GRAMMAR
cards.text: Full-frame pictures, hard cuts, frequent 2–4s changes. Dark blue anatomy and cool ordinary home scenes first; warmer home/product images after the reveal. Text is added in the editor.

cards.title: PRODUCTION STACK
cards.text: GPT Image 2.5 for stills, Google Omni for video, one continuous narration take. Assemble in the internal adengine timeline editor. HyperFrames and Remotion are prohibited.

cards.title: CONTINUITY
cards.text: One woman about 55–60, shoulder-length salt-and-pepper hair, grey cotton tee, normal skin texture. Same bathroom and kitchen. One coherent anatomy model. One verified bottle reference for every product shot.

cards.title: CLAIM REVIEW — CONCRETE ISSUE
cards.text: Existing product-development evidence does not establish celery/apigenin as a human stomach-restart treatment. The prior script overstates colon-only remedy action and ingredient effects. Preserve the script for review, but do not render restart, nerve-repair, empty-colon or guaranteed gas-binding demonstrations from it.

cards.title: BOTTLE REFERENCE HOLD
cards.text: The stored photo has the historical 5g fiber label. Formula records and live-page numbers conflict. This image is provenance only; confirm current bottle/label before GPT Image 2.5 product work.

cards.title: FIRST PRODUCTION BATCH
cards.text: Establish the recurring woman/home anchor, neutral anatomy anchor and ingredient still life. Then create shot-specific keyframes using those anchors. Product frames depend on current label confirmation.

cards.title: AUDIO / CAPTIONS
cards.text: One clear, calm female narrator; no invented clinician or patient identity. One uninterrupted take. Captions 2–5 words, black on white rounded backing, within the vertical safe area. Optional low-volume instrumental bed begins after the opening hook.
